1.w: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , O my soul.

2.w: I will praise the Lord as long as I live. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

3.w: Do not trust in princes, or in human beings, who cannot deliver.

4.w: Their life’s breath departs, they return to the ground. On that day their plans die.

5.w: How blessed is the one whose helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God.

6.w: The one who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, who remains forever faithful,

7.w: vindicates the oppressed, and gives food to the hungry. The Lord releases the imprisoned.

8.w: The Lord gives sight to the blind. The Lord lifts up all who are bent over. The Lord loves the godly.

9.w: The Lord protects the resident foreigner. He lifts up the fatherless and the widow, but he opposes the wicked.

10.w: The Lord rules forever, your God, O Zion, throughout the generations to come. Praise the Lord !
